props_in.name: isDark
props_in.description: Controlled dark mode. When provided, overrides the component's internal isDark state. Wire to the host's global theme state.

props_in.name: audioPlaying
props_in.description: Audio playing state from the page component. When provided, drives the audio icon visual (speaker waves). Wire to the value returned by the page's onAudioStateChange callback.

props_in.name: hidden
props_in.description: Scroll-direction hide. When true, slides the bar out of frame via transform: translateY(-100%). Drive from a host scroll handler that detects scroll direction. Default: false.

callbacks_out.name: onIsDarkChange
callbacks_out.description: Fires when the user taps the dark/light toggle icon. Receives the new boolean value. Wire to the host's isDark state setter.

callbacks_out.name: onAudioToggle
callbacks_out.description: Fires when the user taps the audio icon. Wire to the audio toggle function registered by the page component via registerAudioToggle.

self_managed.name: scrollState
self_managed.description: Bar appearance state. In production: drive from host scroll handler (ghost at top, glass after threshold). Default: "soft". Canvas/testing: pass directly.

self_managed.name: isMobile
self_managed.description: Breakpoint flag. In production: derive from viewport width (suggested breakpoint: < 768px). Default: false.

self_managed.name: isTablet
self_managed.description: Breakpoint flag. Accepted but not yet used in layout logic — reserved for future tablet-specific behaviour. Default: false.

self_managed.name: defaultMenuOpen
self_managed.description: Initial menu open state. Always false in production. Canvas and testing use only.

mockup_only.name: overlayItemStyle
mockup_only.description: Style override for mobile overlay nav items. Canvas comparison use only — not used in production.

mockup_only.name: overlayGlass
mockup_only.description: Glass comparison override for the mobile overlay background. Canvas use only — not used in production.

mockup_only.name: wordmarkFont
mockup_only.description: Wordmark font variant. Locked to "raleway" in production. Canvas A/B comparison use only.

mockup_only.name: wordmarkTracking
mockup_only.description: Raleway wordmark letter-spacing override. Canvas comparison use only — not used in production.

notes.mustHaveBehaviour: GLOBAL_NAV_CAPSULE.md is normative. Its default theme, persistent toggle, browser-unlock, waterfall audio fade-in, and no-audio-page requirements must be implemented without agent discretion.
notes.clickOutside: The EXPLORE drop panel dismisses via a transparent fixed backdrop div (z 998) that sits below the nav bar (z 1000) and panel (z 999). No document-level event listeners are used.
notes.fonts: Fonts must be loaded by the host shell <head> before this component mounts. See declarations.json for the Google Fonts URL. The internal useLoadBrandFonts() call is a no-op kept for compatibility.
notes.audioIcon: The nav audio icon is visual-only — it does not manage audio playback. It fires onAudioToggle and reflects the audioPlaying state passed in. The page component owns the audio engine.
notes.languageSelector: Only EN is active at launch. NO, DE, FR, NL are rendered but non-interactive. Implement routing when additional locales go live.
